```artifact
Feature: Alarms and Temperature Sensing

  Scenario: Battery failure alarm has high priority
    Given the system is operational
    When a battery failure is detected
    Then the battery failure alarm should have high priority

  Scenario Outline: GUI reads temperature sensors for blower motor, blower power mgmt system, and battery cell
    Given the system is operational
    When the temperature of the <component> is read
    Then the GUI should display the temperature of the <component>
    Examples:
      | component             |
      | blower motor          |
      | blower power mgmt system |
      | battery cell          |

  Scenario Outline: Blower motor temperature too high alarm triggered by user-specified threshold
    Given the system is operational
    And the user has set the blower motor temperature threshold to <threshold>
    When the blower motor temperature reaches <temperature>
    Then the "blower motor temperature too high" alarm should be triggered
    Examples:
      | threshold | temperature | kind      |
      | 80        | 85          | positive  |
      | 80        | 80          | boundary  |
      | 80        | 79          | negative  |

  Scenario Outline: Blower power system temperature too high alarm triggered by user-specified threshold
    Given the system is operational
    And the user has set the blower power system temperature threshold to <threshold>
    When the blower power system temperature reaches <temperature>
    Then the "blower power system temperature too high" alarm should be triggered
    Examples:
      | threshold | temperature | kind      |
      | 90        | 95          | positive  |
      | 90        | 90          | boundary  |
      | 90        | 89          | negative  |

  Scenario Outline: Battery temperature too high alarm triggered by user-specified threshold
    Given the system is operational
    And the user has set the battery temperature threshold to <threshold>
    When the battery temperature reaches <temperature>
    Then the "battery temperature too high" alarm should be triggered
    Examples:
      | threshold | temperature | kind      |
      | 75        | 80          | positive  |
      | 75        | 75          | boundary  |
      | 75        | 74          | negative  |

  Scenario Outline: Safety action invoked when blower power system temperature is above threshold
    Given the system is operational
    And the user has set the blower power system temperature threshold to <threshold>
    When the blower power system temperature reaches <temperature>
    Then the system should automatically invoke a safety action
    Examples:
      | threshold | temperature | kind      |
      | 90        | 95          | positive  |
      | 90        | 90          | boundary  |
      | 90        | 89          | negative  |

  Scenario Outline: Safety action invoked when battery temperature is above threshold
    Given the system is operational
    And the user has set the battery temperature threshold to <threshold>
    When the battery temperature reaches <temperature>
    Then the system should automatically invoke a safety action
    Examples:
      | threshold | temperature | kind      |
      | 75        | 80          | positive  |
      | 75        | 75          | boundary  |
      | 75        | 74          | negative  |
```
